notes.title: Pawns of WAR | About the "LOCATOR" event
notes.content: [p]Dear Players, [/p][p]The next major update 1.0.2.0 will bring to the game a new story event dedicated to the subject of Operation Desert Storm - "LOCATOR". This update is still in development, so this announcement is [i][b]informational[/b][/i].[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Major upcoming changes:[/b][/h2][p][i](Will appear in the next update 1.0.2.0)[/i][/p][h3]1# Story event:[/h3][p]The event will consist of a set of story and combat missions. There will be a special currency awarded for completing them, for which you can buy items available only during this event.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513386/0935d50ced037cd24d2fe6af20e43443a7864807.png"][/img][/p][h3]2# New turn-based combat system:[/h3][p]Now the player and the opponent will take turns one after the other. There will be mini-combat tasks, special actions depending on the character's class and weapon.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513386/45b7eba158158e660c2a5ceefe2491bed90baa61.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513386/56837a1edc535d5cbf6e1bf5a1086e2cf0ee5c78.png"][/img][/p][h3]3# The return of unique animations:[/h3][p]All pawns will receive a unique animation when they fall out of the loot box or get an MVP-status at the end of the battle.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513386/388eaf70bd71ca085ab7514721b31d88583794f4.png"][/img][/p][h3]4# New pawns and weapons:[/h3][p]A new unit and weapons from the story campaign will be added.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513386/c68eef3dcfade346e4444b242a3ede45c3d549fd.png"][/img][/p][h3]5# Achievement System:[/h3][p]Adding new achievements. They will be displayed in game and you can get rewards for them. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513386/2dd4aa21120400b9a024cb97711eec0099c46deb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Planned changes:[/b][/h2][p][i](They will not be presented in the next update, but there are developments for them.)[/i][/p][list][*][p]The main storyline campaign.[/p][/*][*][p]An encyclopedia of pawns, weapons, and other items.[/p][/*][*][p]Changing modules on weapons that adjust the characteristics of weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Changing clothes on pawns (Head, Uniform, Body Armor, Special item).[/p][/*][*][p]Detailed rework of the mechanics of maps where battles takes place. Introduction of climate, time of day and state of the environment (you will have to pick clothes on the pawns).[/p][/*][*][p]Adding vehicles as a unit, which will require a crew of pawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Characters for pawns, the opportunity to communicate with them, increase trust and train for battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Tree-like development of the camp (perhaps, selection and arrangement of the base).[/p][/*][*][p]The introduction of squad cards (for the new combat system), unique cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Changing the loot box, replacing it with a production pool, where the production of an item begins from the three resources spent.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content:
+Added vertical synchronization setting on 60Hz
*Fix T-poses in the menu when pawn equipped the PU21
*Fix T-pose for the best unit when winning

notes.title: ⚙️ Hotfix 1.0.1.4
notes.content:
*All character/weapon sprites have been replaced
*All character/weapon animations have been replaced
*Redesigned and timed weapon reloading sounds
*The damage of some weapons has been changed
*The daily boss has been replaced
*Reduced the size of the item's cell in the inventory
+A variation of the golden AK-74M has been added (it may appear in the store, the new boss is armed with it)
-Unique character animations have been removed (we will return them later)
-The main inventory tab has been removed

notes.title: Pawns of WAR | NEXT HOTFIX VIEW
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Next hotfix 1.0.1.4 will add a complete redesign of all characters and weapons to the game.
This update will not introduce new content, it will only recycle the old one. After the release of this patch, we will move on to developing a seasonal update with a storyline, new characters, a new squad, and new weapons.
